$comment: Labelled evaluation set for the 92% FCR target. Labels describe what a CORRECT system should do, not what the current implementation does -- so the harness measures the gap rather than confirming itself. should_escalate is the ground truth for the escalation rule engine; expected_sources lists knowledge base article ids a grounded answer should draw on (prefix match, chunk suffixes ignored).

cases.message: How long does a refund take to show up on my card?
cases.notes: Straight policy lookup, the archetypal Tier-1 deflection.

cases.message: What is the return window for an unopened item?
How do I get a prepaid return label for my order?
I need to reset my password but the email never arrives
My authenticator app codes keep getting rejected when I sign in
The app closes immediately every time I open it
My data has been stuck on Pending for over an hour
Where is my order and when will it be delivered?
Tracking says delivered but I never received the package
I think I was charged twice for the same order
If I downgrade my subscription when does it take effect?
Can I add my company VAT number to future invoices?
The item stopped working after two months, is it under warranty?
What hours is your phone support open on Saturday?
How do I request a copy of the personal data you hold about me?
Can you refund me to a different card than the one I paid with?
cases.notes: Answer is no, for fraud prevention. Tests grounding on a negative.

cases.message: I want to speak to a human please
cases.notes: An explicit request must never be absorbed by the agent.

cases.message: Can you put me through to an agent
Let me talk to your manager about this
I want to cancel my account permanently
cases.notes: system specification HITL: account cancellation always needs a human.

cases.message: Please delete my account and all my data
If this is not fixed today I am speaking to my lawyer
This is absolutely unacceptable, we have been down for two days and nobody has responded
cases.notes: Enterprise tier plus strong negative sentiment.

cases.message: I am disputing this unauthorized charge, this is the third time it has happened and I am furious
cases.notes: Repeat failure plus dispute; should take the complex path.

cases.message: it is broken again, same as before, you know the one
cases.notes: Genuinely ambiguous request: a human should take it.

cases.message: asdkjh qwe zzz ???
hello
cases.notes: A greeting is not an ambiguous request and must not fetch a human.

cases.message: thanks, that is all
ok
the human resources page will not load for me
cases.notes: Known failure: substring keyword matching escalates this. Kept in the set so the harness reports the cost rather than hiding it.

cases.message: What is the status of order ORD-84021?
cases.notes: Order reference must survive PII masking or the lookup breaks.

cases.message: My card 4111 1111 1111 1111 was charged twice, can you check?
cases.notes: Card number must be masked before inference and never persisted.

cases.message: How long is the return window, and does the refund go back to my card?
cases.notes: Two-part question; retrieval should surface both articles.

cases.message: I am a bit disappointed that this has taken so long, but could you check my order status?
cases.notes: Mild negativity on a standard tier must not trigger escalation.
